items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Up on the sixth floor was the A&R Studios, run by Phil Ramone, who is a famous A&R man today.

ctx.x: What’s this place Jim & Andy’s bar?

Jim & Andy’s was where all the musicians hung out. Jim Koulouvaris was the owner of the bar. Jim used to loan money to any musician in town that needed it. His pay phone was the hangout for every musician in town. The phone rang one day, and of course whoever was closest to the phone would answer it. I answered the phone, I says hello. “Is Nick Travis there?” I says, “Yeah, just a minute.” I said, “Hey Nick, it’s for you.” Nick went to the phone and he picked it up and he says, “Yeah this is Nick.” And the voice…
So people would call down there—
